label: TP
reason: The Referer header is retrieved, URL-decoded, and passed to doSomething() which assigns it to bar. The value of bar is then written to the HTTP response without any sanitization, creating a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

evidence.note: Referer header is retrieved, decoded, and passed to doSomething()
doSomething() assigns user-provided param to bar regardless of conditional logic
bar is written directly to response writer, creating XSS sink
